_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil: opposing extremes cancel, F&G 48 sits on the Anxiety/Complacency edge, and base-rate 12h moves rarely break without a clear impulse.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both treat current state as Anxiety/measured HOLD; only analyst supplies forward Complacency; narrative has no directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: Score and F&G remain in 47-54 with muted 30d momentum and no sustained ETF-flow or funding impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with score push to 55+ Disbelief, or F&G breaks under 39 with VIX/netflow confirming a down-leg
